# DELETE /api/v1/repos/{owner}/{repo}/topics/{topic}

Delete a topic from a repository

**Module:** [routers](../modules/routers.md) · **Auth:** bearer (write access required) · **ID:** `ep-350`

## Request

| Param | Location | Type | Required |
|-------|----------|------|----------|
| owner | path | string | True |
| repo | path | string | True |
| topic | path | string | True |

## Response

**204** — empty

- **404** — Topic not found on repo
- **422** — Invalid topic name format

| Step | Module | Component | Type | Details |

| 2 | [models](../modules/models.md) | repo_model.DeleteTopic | repository | Check if repo has topic; If found: decrement repo_count, delete repo_topic link, sync repository topics |

## Business Rules

| Rule | Category | Condition |
|------|----------|-----------|
| Topic names must match pattern ^[a-z0-9][-.a-z0-9]*$ and be max 35 chars | validation | len(topic) > 35 || !topicPattern.MatchString(topic) |
| Topic names are normalized to lowercase and trimmed before processing | business_logic | Always |
| Topic repo_count is maintained as a denormalized counter, incremented on add, decremented on remove | business_logic | Topic added or removed from repo |
| After topic changes, the repository.topics field is synced with current topic names | business_logic | After any topic add/remove/save |

### Error Paths

- **Invalid topic name** → DeleteTopic → 422
- **Topic not on repo (nil returned)** → DeleteTopic → 404
- **DB error** → DeleteTopic → 500
